name: FieldBrain Connect
author: fieldbraindev

sections.description:
FieldBrain Connect is the official lightweight WordPress connector for FieldBrain subscribers.

Once activated, simply enter your FieldBrain Company ID (found inside your FieldBrain Dashboard under Settings → Website Integration). The plugin automatically injects the master script (fb.js) to power your active FieldBrain website widgets (such as local schema, review showcases, and web chat) and unlocks the [fieldbrain_map] shortcode to embed interactive project maps directly on your site.

Note: Requires an active FieldBrain account with Website Integration enabled.

Features Included in v1.0.0

  • Master Script Sync: Automatically injects the FieldBrain tracking & widget script across your site.
  • Local Project Map Embed: Display your interactive project pins using the [fieldbrain_map] shortcode.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Zero bloat, clean script loading, and full compatibility with Gutenberg & page builders.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by FieldBrain to enable website analytics, pixel tracking, and AI web widgets.

  • FieldBrain Pixel Service (app.fieldbrain.app):
    • What it is used for: Loads the FieldBrain tracking pixel script and web chat widgets onto your site.
    • What data is sent: Transmits pageview metadata, visitor referral data, and interaction events to your FieldBrain dashboard when loaded.
    • Terms of Service: https://fieldbrain.app/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://fieldbrain.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fieldbrain-connect folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> FieldBrain Connect and enter your FieldBrain Company ID.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my FieldBrain Company ID?

Log into your FieldBrain Dashboard, navigate to Settings -> Website Integration, and copy your Company ID string.
